conditions.name: days
conditions.rule: At least 126 trading days of live results

conditions.name: total_return
conditions.rule: Total return after costs above buying and holding SPY

conditions.name: significance
conditions.rule: Daily excess return over SPY with a t-statistic above 2

conditions.name: sharpe
conditions.rule: Sharpe ratio above SPY's over the same days

conditions.name: drawdown
conditions.rule: Worst drop no more than 5 points deeper than SPY's

conditions.name: consistency
conditions.rule: Beat SPY in at least 2 of the last 3 blocks

conditions.name: champion_days
conditions.rule: The current model version has at least 60 live days of its own
